Hey Trick or Treaters! I hope your not afraid of sharks. This week, we added our lake monster who is usually pretty friendly. But come Hallow's eve, he cant control his sweet tooth. If you explore the board enough, you just may unlock him. Who knows, maybe you can use him for your advantage...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040607/54d02c1c6ebae3e663356af6258aa4f5ea861cc2.png[/img]

Hello Trick or Treaters! This week, we worked on implementing the gate mechanic. Unlock parts of the map at the expense of your own candy in hopes to increase your chance of winning! But beware, this too comes with risks...
